# MyBakuriani

> MyBakuriani (mybakuriani.ge) is a marketplace and local guide for Bakuriani, a ski and mountain resort in Samtskhe-Javakheti, Georgia. Owners list apartments, cottages and hotels to rent by the day or to buy; local businesses list restaurants, transfers, entertainment, services and jobs. Pages are in Georgian (the default, no URL prefix), English (/en) and Russian (/ru).

Listings are written by their owners and each one has a single canonical page. The home page shows weather, road and ski-lift status when they are available.

## Resort guide

- [Bakuriani guide](https://mybakuriani.ge/en/bakuriani): the season, the areas, the road from Tbilisi and where to stay
- [Getting to Bakuriani](https://mybakuriani.ge/en/bakuriani/getting-there): by car, private transfer or minibus
- [Ski lifts](https://mybakuriani.ge/en/bakuriani/ski-lifts): Didveli, Kokhta and Mitarbi, and where to check opening dates
- [Didveli / Crystal](https://mybakuriani.ge/en/bakuriani/didveli): the area close to the slopes
- [Kokhta / Mitarbi](https://mybakuriani.ge/en/bakuriani/kokhta): the premium area with the new cable cars
- [Bakuriani centre](https://mybakuriani.ge/en/bakuriani/centri): restaurants, entertainment and the central park
- [25-ianebi](https://mybakuriani.ge/en/bakuriani/25ianebi): the area of affordable apartments

## Where to stay

- [Apartments and cottages](https://mybakuriani.ge/en/apartments): daily rentals
- [Hotels](https://mybakuriani.ge/en/hotels)
- [Property for sale](https://mybakuriani.ge/en/sales): apartments, cottages and land
